sql_query: SELECT T2.name FROM TeamsSC AS T1 INNER JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year = '1917' AND T1.W > T1.L
source_search_question: What was the reason for the Toronto Arenas suspending operations after the 1918–19 season?
source_search_answer: The Toronto Arenas suspended operations after the 1918–19 season due to mounting legal bills from a dispute, which forced them to sell most of their star players. This resulted in a poor five-win season, financial losses, and no hope of competing effectively in the standings of the three-team league. Consequently, they requested permission to suspend operations in late February 1919.
